description: This file contains code for registering, validating, and unregistering a service worker in a React application, including environment checks and update handling.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Main function to register the service worker if in production environment and supported by the browser.

methods.name: registerValidSW
methods.description: Registers the service worker and sets up update and state change handlers.

methods.name: checkValidServiceWorker
methods.description: Checks if the service worker script exists and is valid, otherwise reloads the page.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the service worker if supported.
